intro: Malawi is mostly agricultural and one of the poorest countries in the world.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Tobacco is the top export, followed by tea, sugar and macadamia nuts. Most families grow maize.

chapters.title: Challenges
text: Droughts, cyclones and fuel shortages have hit the economy.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Malawi makes and sells to the world.
